supersedes.reason: Initial 7a78c86 deploy used a bytes24 DOMAIN_OPRF_ROOT digest scheme that didn't match backend's live signer. Replaced with the team-lead-pinned EIP-191 + chainid + address(this) scheme in commit 486cb0d. Old addresses remain on-chain but are unusable — backend signatures will never verify against them.
